plugins.name: OpenAI Key Middleware
plugins.description: Validates OpenAI API key hygiene before every deploy and appends a usage-tracking banner comment.
plugins.author: edge-deployer
plugins.install: Copy plugins/examples/openai-middleware/ into your plugin directory

plugins.name: Env Variable Injector
plugins.description: Scans for env.VARNAME and process.env.VARNAME references, prepends a JSDoc block listing all required variables.
plugins.author: edge-deployer
plugins.install: Copy plugins/examples/env-injector/ into your plugin directory

plugins.name: Request Logger
plugins.description: Wraps your fetch handler with structured request/response logging — method, URL, status, latency.
plugins.author: edge-deployer
plugins.install: Copy plugins/examples/request-logger/ into your plugin directory

plugins.name: Console Stripper
plugins.description: Removes all console.log / console.debug calls before deploy to keep production clean.
plugins.author: edge-deployer

plugins.name: CORS Header Injector
plugins.description: Adds Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Allow-Methods, and Access-Control-Allow-Headers to every response via code transform.
plugins.author: edge-deployer

plugins.name: Sentry Error Tracking
plugins.description: Wraps your Worker with Sentry error capturing. Requires SENTRY_DSN environment variable.
plugins.author: community
plugins.install: Coming soon — submit your plugin via a GitHub issue

plugins.name: CSP Header Generator
plugins.description: Injects a strict Content-Security-Policy header based on your worker's output type (HTML/JSON/binary).
plugins.author: community
plugins.install: Coming soon — submit your plugin via a GitHub issue
